meanings: (used after an attribute when it modifies a noun)
(used at the end of a declarative sentence for emphasis)
also pr. [di4] or [di5] in poetry and songs

makemeahanzi.definition: aim, goal; of; possessive particle; -self suffix
I, me, my; our, us

etymology.hint: A hand 扌 holding a weapon 戈

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally depicted a hand 扌 gripping a weapon 戈; this original meaning was later borrowed to represent the pronoun 'I/we.'

meanings: you (informal, as opposed to courteous 您[nin2])

makemeahanzi.definition: you, second person pronoun

etymology.hint: Pronoun 尔 for a person 亻

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) plus 尔 (an old second-person pronoun) — combines to form 你, the modern word for 'you.'

meanings: (respectful acknowledgement of a command) very well

makemeahanzi.definition: to be; indeed, right, yes; okay

etymology.hint: To speak 日 directly 疋

characterDeckComponents.note: Traditionally analyzed as 日 combined with 疋, linked to the idea of speaking directly and truthfully — the source of 是's meaning 'to be, indeed, right.'

meanings: (modal particle indicating change of state, situation now)

makemeahanzi.definition: clear; to finish; particle of completed action

etymology.hint: A child swaddled in blanklets; compare 子

characterDeckComponents.note: Depicts a child wrapped in swaddling, related to 子 (child); the picture-meaning has nothing to do with its modern grammatical role marking a completed action or change of state.

makemeahanzi.definition: no, not, un-; negative prefix

etymology.hint: A bird flying toward the sky 一

characterDeckComponents.note: The oracle-bone form has been interpreted as a bird flying up toward the sky; the meaning later shifted entirely to represent negation, 'not.'

meanings: (of sb or sth) to be (located) at
(used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)

makemeahanzi.definition: at, in, on; to exist; used to indicate the present progressive tense

etymology.hint: earth

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth/soil) — 在 originally related to standing on the ground
才 (cái) gives the sound — 在 is pronounced zài, a close match

makemeahanzi.definition: other, another; he, she, it

etymology.hint: An additional, "also" 也  person 亻

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) plus 也 (also/additionally) — historically meant 'another person,' which developed into the third-person pronoun 'he/him.'

makemeahanzi.definition: good, excellent, fine; proper, suitable; well

etymology.hint: A woman 女 with a son 子

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — represents a mother.
子 (child/son) — a mother together with her child was seen as an image of goodness, giving 好 its meaning 'good.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to have, to own, to possess; to exist

characterDeckComponents.note: 月 (yuè) here actually derives from 肉 (meat) — 有 originally depicted a hand holding meat, meaning 'to possess'; it also lends a loose phonetic connection to yǒu.

makemeahanzi.definition: this, these; such; here

meanings: (after a suppositional clause) in that case
(after a clause of action) as soon as

makemeahanzi.definition: just, simply; to go to; to approach, near

etymology.hint: specialty

characterDeckComponents.note: 尤 (particularly/outstanding) — relates to 就's sense of approaching or arriving at a particular point
京 (jīng, capital) gives a sound close to 就's pronunciation jiù

makemeahanzi.definition: to assemble, to meet; meeting; association, group

etymology.hint: People 人 speaking 云

characterDeckComponents.note: 人 (people) over 云 (clouds/say) — a picture of people gathering and speaking together, related to 会's meanings 'to meet' and 'to know how to.'

makemeahanzi.definition: final interrogative particle

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — relates to 吗's role as a spoken question particle.
马 (mǎ) provides the base sound, though 吗 is usually spoken with a neutral, unstressed tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: essential, necessary; to ask for; to coerce; to demand

etymology.hint: A woman 女 with hands on her waist 覀

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) with 覀 depicting hands on the waist — an old image of insisting or demanding something, connected to 要's meaning 'to want, to need.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to speak, to say; to scold, to upbraid

etymology.hint: speech

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech radical) — shows 说 relates to talking or language
兑 (duì) is the phonetic component; historically 说 was also pronounced closer to 兑's sound before shifting to shuō

makemeahanzi.definition: she, her

etymology.hint: A woman 女 beside you 也

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — marks this pronoun as specifically feminine.
也 was already used as a gender-neutral third-person pronoun; adding 女 to it created a new character specifically for 'she.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to believe, to wish for; to consider, to plan, to think

etymology.hint: mind

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart/mind) — 想 relates to thinking, missing someone, or wanting something in one's heart.
相 (xiāng) gives the sound — 想 is pronounced xiǎng, matching aside from tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: one; a, an; alone

etymology.hint: Represents heaven (天), earth (旦), or the number 1

characterDeckComponents.note: A single horizontal stroke — the simplest possible way to represent the number one; some traditional interpretations link it to heaven or earth as the very first stroke of creation.

makemeahanzi.definition: very, quite, much

etymology.hint: step

characterDeckComponents.note: 彳 (step, to walk) — an older, now faded connection tied to movement.
艮 (gèn) gives a hint of the sound — 很 is pronounced hěn, a connection that has drifted significantly over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: man, person; people

etymology.hint: The legs of a human being

characterDeckComponents.note: A simple line drawing of a person's legs seen from the side, used to depict a human being.

meanings: abbr. for 貼吧|贴吧[tie1 ba1]

makemeahanzi.definition: emphatic final particle

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 吧 is a spoken particle, tied to speech and the mouth
巴 (bā) gives the sound — 吧 is pronounced ba, a related (unstressed) form of the same sound

makemeahanzi.definition: that, that one, those

meanings: (used as a substitute for a more specific verb)

makemeahanzi.definition: to arrive, to come, to return; in the future, later on

etymology.hint: A wheat plant that has not yet borne fruit; compare 來

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally depicted a wheat plant; this agricultural picture was borrowed early on to represent the unrelated verb 'to come.'

makemeahanzi.definition: all, each, entirely, whole; metropolis; capital

etymology.hint: city

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a variant of 邑, meaning city/settlement) — 都 relates to a capital or metropolis.
者 (zhě) is the historical phonetic element; its modern reading no longer closely matches dōu, reflecting centuries of sound change.

meanings: used in 自個兒|自个儿[zi4 ge3 r5]

makemeahanzi.definition: this, that; single; measure word for individuals

etymology.hint: A tally 丨 of people 人

characterDeckComponents.note: 丨 (a vertical tally mark) over 人 (person) — suggests counting people one by one, fitting 个's role today as Mandarin's most common general measure word.

makemeahanzi.definition: can, may; capable, full of energy

etymology.hint: A bear's head 厶, body ⺼, and claws 匕

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally a drawing of a bear, with 厶 as its head, ⺼ as its body, and 匕匕 as its claws; the picture was later borrowed to mean 'ability, to be able to.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to go away, to leave, to depart
not, none, gone; to bury; to sink, to drown

etymology.hint: water

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 没 originally meant to sink or drown in water, later extended to the negative 'not have.'
殳 (shū) is the historical sound component; it no longer rhymes with méi in modern Mandarin, another case of sound drift over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: harmony, peace; calm, peaceful

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — ties to harmony as speaking together in accord
禾 (hé, grain) gives the sound — matches 和's pronunciation hé

makemeahanzi.definition: to go to, to arrive

etymology.hint: arrive

characterDeckComponents.note: 至 (zhì, to arrive) — carries 到's core meaning, 'to reach, to arrive'
刂 (a form of 刀, dāo) gives a sound close to 到's pronunciation dào

makemeahanzi.definition: correct, right; facing, opposed

etymology.hint: A pair 又 of hands 寸

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (hand) and 寸 (also derived from a hand shape) — together suggesting two hands matching or corresponding, related to 对's meaning 'correct, matching.'

meanings: (literary) particle having functions similar to 啊[a5]

makemeahanzi.definition: also, too
ah, exclamatory particle

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 啊 is an exclamation made with the mouth
阿 (ā) gives a sound close to 啊's reading a, sharing the same base sound

makemeahanzi.definition: also, besides; still, yet; to return

etymology.hint: Not 不 moving 辶

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk/move) — relates to motion or progress.
不 (not) — 'not yet moving on' gave 还 its meaning of 'still, yet.'

meanings: to hold a baby in position to help it urinate or defecate

makemeahanzi.definition: to grasp, to hold; to guard, to take; handle

etymology.hint: hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 把 relates to grasping or holding something with the hand.
巴 (bā) gives the sound — 把 is pronounced bǎ, a close match differing only in tone.

meanings: by (indicates the agent in a passive clause, like 被[bei4])

makemeahanzi.definition: to allow, to permit, to yield

etymology.hint: speech

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — relates to 让's meaning 'to let, allow, yield,' something granted through spoken permission.
上 (shàng) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from ràng.

makemeahanzi.definition: to work, to make; to act

etymology.hint: Someone 亻 who causes things to happen 故; 故 also provides the pronuncation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 做 relates to a person carrying out an action.
故 (cause, reason, to happen) — combined with 亻 (person), 做 came to mean 'to make' or 'to do,' someone actively causing something to happen.

makemeahanzi.definition: to give, to lend; for, by

etymology.hint: thread

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread/silk) — 给 originally related to supplying thread or material, later broadening to mean 'to give.'
合 (hé) gives a hint of the sound — 给 is pronounced gěi, a connection that has shifted over time.

meanings: used in 上聲|上声[shang3 sheng1]

makemeahanzi.definition: above, on top, superior; to go up; to attend; previous

etymology.hint: One stroke on top of another; compare 下 (below)

characterDeckComponents.note: A short stroke placed above a longer one — a simple graphic way to show 'up' or 'above,' contrasted with 下 (down), which flips the strokes.

makemeahanzi.definition: pass; to go across, to pass through

etymology.hint: walk

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk/move) — shows 过's core meaning of 'passing through' or 'crossing'
咼 (guō) gives a sound close to 过's reading guò; the simplified form 过 now uses 寸 in place of 咼, but the phonetic connection traces back to the traditional character 過

makemeahanzi.definition: to obtain, to get, to acquire; suitable, proper; ready

etymology.hint: A hand 寸 grabbing a shell 旦

characterDeckComponents.note: 寸 (a hand) reaching for 旦 (originally 貝, a shell used as currency) — a picture of grasping something valuable, hence 'to obtain, to get.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to look, to see; to examine, to scrutinize

etymology.hint: Shielding one's eyes 目 with a hand 手 to look to the distance

characterDeckComponents.note: 手 (hand) — depicts a hand raised above the eyes.
目 (eye) — shielding the eyes with a hand to look into the distance gave 看 its meaning 'to look, to see.'

makemeahanzi.definition: real, actual, true, genuine

etymology.hint: A straight 直 (that is, level) table 几

characterDeckComponents.note: 直 (straight, upright) — 真 relates to something level and true.
几 (a small table) — an object placed level and true on a table gave 真 its meaning 'real' or 'true.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to make a move, to take action
affair, matter, business; to serve; accident, incident
dot, point, speck

etymology.hint: fire

characterDeckComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — 点 originally related to a small flame or dot of light, giving rise to the meaning 'dot' or 'point.'
占 (zhàn) gives a hint of the sound — 点 is pronounced diǎn, a connection that has drifted over the centuries.

makemeahanzi.definition: wool; interrogative or emphatic final particle

etymology.hint: mouth

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — relates to 呢's role as a spoken sentence particle.
尼 (ní) provides the base sound, though 呢 is usually spoken with a neutral, unstressed tone.

meanings: grain that has begun to ripen

makemeahanzi.definition: only, merely, just

etymology.hint: Simple words 八 coming from the mouth 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — the source of speech.
八 here suggests something small or simple leaving the mouth, giving 只 its meaning 'only, merely.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to separate, to distinguish, to classify; to leave; other; do not, must not

etymology.hint: To draw boundaries 刂 between classes 另

characterDeckComponents.note: 另 (other, separate) — 别 relates to distinguishing one thing from another.
刂 (knife) — cutting things apart to sort them gave 别 its meaning 'to separate' or 'other,' and later, 'don't' as a command.
